column1: # Power-up map of PR09 (branch video, cb1c70b: the native video of rk_video moved into rk86_video, instance
# native of rk_video). gen_sim --power-up-map: row id (signal@first candidate of power_up.tsv) -> candidate
# modules. The registers of the CRT timebase and the dot shift register are declared in rk86_video after the
# split (h_cnt, v_cnt as output reg), in rk_video before it; v_cnt2, v_cnt_line, the framebuffer and the VGA
# registers stay in rk_video. Exactly one candidate declares each register in either revision.
